title: 3 Methods
use_cases: Implement when needing to align story generation models with specific user action preferences
Configure when training a discriminator model to evaluate the quality of narrative choices
Use when developing a creative storytelling pipeline involving both generative and evaluative models
Use when integrating open-source LLMs into specialized story-action feedback loops
content:
Our creative storytelling method consists of two primary components: the story generation model and the action discriminator model (AD LLM). SWAG enables the use of any open-source LLM or LLM service for story generation. We create an AD LLM by collecting preference data for story actions, and aligning a pretrained LLM on our preference dataset. We visualize our training pipeline in Figure 1 below.

![Refer to caption](https://arxiv.org/html/x1.png)

Figure 1: SWAG AD LLM Training Pipeline. After curating long story and action preference data from GPT-4 and Mixtral-8x7B, we perform SFT on a base open-source LLM, and then align our model with more preference data using DPO to produce our action discriminator model (AD LLM).
